audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 is given to Maokai and 'First item' is given to Nasus in both layers, but the whys[] for those rows say 'it's a wash' and 'it's even at best', and the packet levelChart has both as Skill.
audit.why: At Level 1 each champion has one ability and no combo — Nasus is stacking Siphoning Strike, Maokai has no W-Q chain, so no kill pressure exists either way. At first item Maokai is durable and lane-stable but has no kill threat, while Nasus has not yet reached the stacked 2-item window; neither side owns it.
audit.corrected: phases[0]/win[0] and phases[5]/win[5] set to Skill in both layers, with ratings moved to 5/10 to match.

audit.why: Four spikes present and accurate: Lvl 2-3 root-poke window, Lvl 6 as a modest non-duel spike (Nature's Grasp is engage, Fury of the Sands is HP/resists not burst), 1st item stability, and 2+ items as his takeover.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the file states that Twisted Advance is lock-on and that Maokai is untargetable for the whole dash. The don't 'Fight inside his W slow' is described with filler text about burning an ability for tiny value.
audit.why: The kit file gives Twisted Advance both 'untargetable' and 'hardCC' flags with a target-locked dash. Nasus cannot dodge it, and Wither (15/14/13/12/11s) cannot be applied during the flight — it lands before the cast or after arrival. The mirror audit on nasus reached the same conclusion, so both directions now state it.
audit.corrected: phases[1].why and dontsFull[1].d now state the lock-on and untargetability, and dosFull[0].d carries Wither's real 15s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. Wither is named repeatedly but never with a number.
audit.why: Wither is 15/14/13/12/11 seconds. A baited Wither at rank 1 is a 15-second window in which Maokai's W (14s at rank 1) is effectively back — that is what makes the sequencing concrete.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now reads with the 15s rank-1 figure.

edits.before: Passive heal + AA trades carry the early waves. Identify how Nasus contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: One ability each and no combo — he is stacking Siphoning Strike, you are waiting on W-Q, so Level 1 is a genuine wash.

edits.before: W root is your engage AND your peel — spend it once per fight. Only take the trade when Nasus's Wither is down.
edits.after: Twisted Advance is lock-on and untargetable in flight — undodgeable, and Wither cannot catch you mid-dash. Trade now.

edits.before: Heartsteel is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Wither's cooldown.
edits.after: Durable and lane-stable on first item, but you cannot kill him and every minute stacks his Q.

edits.before: His only kite. Root through it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His only kite, 15s at rank 1. Engage the moment it is down or baited.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Wither cannot land during your W dash — you are untargetable in flight.
